_comment: MK7BoostGauge config. Copy to /var/lib/boostgauge/config.json on Pi. Editable via web UI.
_skip_dead_zone_help: MQB cluster needle freezes for temp in [80,110]°C. When true, mapping splits MAP range over [50,80] + [110,130] to skip the dead zone — needle moves continuously across full MAP range.

can._comment: CAN0 = always Cluster bus. CAN1 = either PCM (Powertrain) or Diagnostic (OBD-II) — togglable in UI without rebooting.
can._can1_listen_only_help: When true, blocks ALL TX on CAN1 even in Diagnostic mode (extra safety).
can._map_source_help: auto = sniff if PCM mode, UDS if Diagnostic. broadcast = sniff only. uds = query only.

wifi._comment: Read by ap_setup.sh, NOT by the Python app (Python doesn't manage WiFi).

safety._comment: Hard-block list at can_manager send level. Airbag IDs blacklisted no matter what.
